description.value: Fresh Bite Food is a kebab and sandwich counter that opened its first location in 2024, backed by over a decade of culinary experience. The menu centres on grilled koobideh and chicken kebab sandwiches as well as Philly-style cheese steaks, all served in fresh pitta bread with a generous spread of toppings. A vegetarian chickpea-and-kidney-bean sandwich rounds out the menu, making it a handy refuelling stop for cyclists riding through Port Coquitlam.

address.value: 2641 Shaughnessy St, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 3G5
